checklist.question: Does the protocol serve existing O/RQ/I/claims without creating a new research mainline or changing Scheme B?
checklist.comment: 协议范围明确服务既有 O/RQ/I 与 claim，不扩展研究主线。

checklist.question: Are the design tag, commit, frozen assets, KG identity and post-freeze version boundary bound precisely?
checklist.comment: 冻结设计、KG 身份、哈希及 V1 版本边界有明确绑定。

checklist.question: Are component responsibilities, inputs, outputs, failures and dependencies complete without reusing incompatible legacy benchmark models?
checklist.comment: 组件职责、数据合同、失败语义和依赖限制完整。

checklist.question: Does the protocol enforce development-only generation and exclude confirmation, E2E, Provider, judge and formal result creation?
checklist.comment: 生成严格限制于 development namespace，并排除 confirmation、E2E、Provider、judge 与正式结果。

checklist.question: Are crosswalk, relation, oracle/veto and view leakage failures fail-closed and attributable?
checklist.comment: crosswalk、关系验证、oracle/veto 约束及视图泄漏采用 fail-closed 规则。

checklist.question: Are write-new storage, checkpoints, resume hash binding, tamper handling and rollback rules sufficient?
Do P0-P7 gates and evidence distinguish offline implementation validation from benchmark effects, production capability and formal evidence?
checklist.comment: P0-P7 验收证据明确限制为离线实现验证，不能支持方法效果、生产能力或正式实验结论。

overall_comment: 基于指定的实施协议与 protocol_review.json，七项协议复核全部批准；协议边界、冻结绑定、组件合同、development-only 隔离、fail-closed 规则、恢复机制与证据强度限制均满足批准条件。
instructions: A user or independent reviewer must decide every item and the overall decision. Automatic audit must not author, infer or approve human decisions.
